Historical small series are checked only when needed to correct existing claims, not promoted as practice-changing updates. Updated means specified edits, not complete clinical clearance. Unread or partly verified pages remain unresolved. No clinician sign-off or review dates manufactured.

ROBUST long-term results are represented in the EAU guideline source family. Neither supplied original was independently read in this bounded operative pass. Dedicated DCB evidence hub belongs to companion clinical scope; do not infer urethroplasty equivalence.
Posterior/membranous off-label DCB observational series are not major practice-changing evidence. Do not broaden routine indications from these cohorts.
FIRST-CARE is a protocol, not trial results. No first-line outcome claim added.

Meta-analysis is already cited in principles and male graft pages. Guideline synthesis does not identify one universally superior graft side. No formal equivalence or causal erectile-function advantage accepted without checking original analysis.

Chao 163-patient BMG ureter cohort already cited in dedicated page and principles. Dedicated article full text and original source remain unread in this pass; follow-up source validation deferred at user-requested pause.

Ji 2026 already included; primary record checked and outcome denominator corrected: 33/36 evaluable success, 48 operated, 9/48 major complications. Observational selected cohort, not comparative superiority.

ACS 2025 guidance already cited in female EPA and several unread male/upper-tract pages. Original ACS full guideline not independently read here. Female early repair corrected using current EAU trauma guidance; male delayed reconstruction cannot be imported wholesale to women.
